source_document: Education & Learning Collection Field Guide v1.0

scenarios.text_scenario: You are studying biology and cannot understand how photosynthesis actually works.
examples: Photosynthesis kya hota hai samjhao
Ye process kaise hota hai explain karo
Mujhe photosynthesis samajh nahi aa raha

scenarios.text_scenario: Your teacher explained a physics topic too fast and you want it again in simple words.
examples: Gravity ko simple words mein explain karo
Ye concept clear nahi hua, dobara batao
Aasan bhasha mein samjha do

scenarios.text_scenario: You are revising and want a topic explained from the beginning.
examples: Is chapter ko shuru se samjhao
Basic se explain karo ye topic
Poora concept detail mein batao

scenarios.text_scenario: You are stuck on a maths problem in your homework and want it worked out step by step.
examples: Ye maths ka question solve kar do
Is problem ka solution step by step batao
Mujhe ye sum samajh nahi aa raha, solve karo

scenarios.text_scenario: You attempted a physics numerical but keep getting the wrong answer.
examples: Ye numerical solve karo please
Mera answer galat aa raha hai, solve kar ke dikhao
Is question ko kaise karte hain?

scenarios.text_scenario: You are making notes and need the exact definition of a term.
examples: Mitochondria ki definition batao
Is term ka matlab kya hota hai?
Definition chahiye iski proper

scenarios.text_scenario: You came across an unfamiliar word while reading a textbook.
examples: Inertia ka matlab kya hai?
Ye word ka meaning batao
Iska definition kya hoga?

scenarios.text_scenario: You understood the theory of a concept but it feels abstract without an example.
examples: Iska koi example de do
Real life example batao is concept ka
Ek do examples chahiye samajhne ke liye

scenarios.text_scenario: You are preparing for an exam where you must illustrate answers with examples.
examples: Exam ke liye examples batao
Kuch aur examples do is topic ke
Example ke saath samjhao

scenarios.text_scenario: Your exam is in three days and you want to test yourself on a chapter.
examples: Is chapter pe quiz le lo mera
Mujhe kuch practice questions do
Ek test le lo is topic ka

scenarios.text_scenario: You finished revising and want quick questions to check what you remember.
examples: Mujhse sawaal pucho is chapter se
Quick quiz karo mera
Practice questions puchho

scenarios.text_scenario: You have an English sentence in your textbook and want its Hindi meaning.
examples: Is line ka Hindi translation batao
Iska matlab Hindi mein samjha do
Ye sentence Hindi mein translate karo

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to write something in English but only know how to say it in Hindi.
examples: Ye sentence English mein kaise bolenge?
Iska English translation batao
English mein kaise likhu ye?

scenarios.text_scenario: Exams are a month away and you have no idea how to cover the syllabus.
examples: Exam ke liye study plan bana do
Ek month ka timetable set karo padhai ka
Kaise padhu ki syllabus complete ho jaye?

scenarios.text_scenario: You keep getting distracted and want a daily routine to follow.
examples: Daily study routine bana do mera
Roz kitne ghante padhna chahiye?
Ek schedule banao padhai ka

scenarios.text_scenario: You have an assignment due tomorrow and do not know how to start.
examples: Mera assignment mein help chahiye
Is homework ko kaise karu?
Assignment ka structure samjha do

scenarios.text_scenario: You are writing a project report and want help organising it.
examples: Project report kaise likhu?
Assignment ka format batao
Is homework mein guide karo mujhe

scenarios.text_scenario: You want a good video to learn a topic you find difficult.
examples: Iske liye koi acchi video suggest karo
Konsi video dekhu is topic ke liye?
YouTube pe kya dekhu ye samajhne ke liye?

scenarios.text_scenario: You are choosing a book to prepare for an exam.
examples: Konsi book padhu is subject ke liye?
Koi acha resource batao seekhne ke liye
Best book kaunsi hai preparation ke liye?

scenarios.text_scenario: You solved a question and want to know whether your answer is right.
examples: Mera answer sahi hai kya check karo
Ye solution correct hai ya nahi?
Maine ye kiya hai, verify kar do

scenarios.text_scenario: You wrote a full answer for an exam question and want it reviewed.
examples: Mera answer check kar do
Ye theek likha hai kya?
Dekho ye sahi hai ya galat

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker says something clearly unrelated to studying — everyday chit-chat.
examples: Gaana chala do
Bhookh lag rahi hai yaar
Aaj mausam kaisa hai?

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker asks something belonging to another domain (banking, travel, assistant).
examples: Mera bank balance batao
Train ka PNR status check karo
Kamre ki light bujha do

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker only greets or trails off without a real request.
examples: Haan ji hello
Theek hai phir
Kuch nahi chhodo
